title: Trading APIs
tagline: Real-time charting, backtesting, and execution UIs.
description: I build fast, data-dense trading interfaces — from live candlestick charts and order tickets to paper-trading simulators and tape-replay backtesting harnesses.
highlights: Real-time candlestick and depth charting (TradingView lightweight-charts)
Limit / market order entry with draggable take-profit and stop-loss management
Tape-replay backtesting and trade simulators with live P/L

title: Mapping APIs
tagline: Interactive maps, geospatial routing, and location data.
description: From custom Leaflet overlays to great-circle routing, I integrate mapping and geospatial APIs into responsive, production-grade web apps.
highlights: Leaflet and Mapbox integrations with custom layers and controls
Geocoding, marker clustering, and live location feeds
Published open-source mapping packages on npm

experience.summary: Built a Leaflet threat-map dashboard — custom markers, clustering, and fly-to-coordinate navigation — giving commanders and cyber operators an at-a-glance view of threats across their area of responsibility (AOR).

Used Leaflet to map internet threats by converting IP addresses to latitude/longitude coordinates, plotting them on a global-scale map clustered by area — zooming into a cluster progressively revealed more precise locations.

title: Dockerized Wine
tagline: Running Windows software on Linux — Wine + Vulkan + D3D12, containerized.
description: Packaging Windows applications — from AAA games to trading platforms — into reproducible Linux containers with the Wine compatibility layer and DirectX-to-Vulkan translation.
highlights: Containerizing Windows AAA games to run on Linux via the Wine compatibility layer
Containerizing popular Windows trading platforms like NinjaTrader for Linux deployment
DirectX-to-Vulkan translation (DXVK / VKD3D) for near-native graphics performance
Reproducible game images bundling Wine prefixes, runtimes, and GPU drivers
Tuning Wine configurations for controllers, save data, and stability

experience.summary: Containerized Windows AAA games like Assassin's Creed Valhalla, CONTROL, and Subnautica to run on Linux using the Wine compatibility layer and Vulkan.
